method: Computed the supplied PDF's SHA-256 hash, byte size and page count and compared them with every published evidence catalog.
Extracted text from all eight pages and rendered and visually reviewed the complete seven-page license plus Attachment A site map.
Downloaded the immutable canonical GitHub source anonymously, verified HTTP 200 delivery and matched its byte count and SHA-256 hash to the supplied file.
Verified that the established content-addressed first-page preview exists and that its filename matches its own SHA-256 hash.
Reused established Wexford record 017 as an exact cross-reference because its title and description already preserve the November 19, 2024 issue date and November 19, 2029 expiration date.
verifiedFindings: EGLE issued Solid Waste Disposal Area Operating License 9758 to Wexford County Landfill, LLC on November 19, 2024, with an expiration date of November 19, 2029.
The license describes a 196.4-acre municipal solid-waste landfill at 990 Mackinaw Trail in Manton and identifies facility ID 470336.
The license incorporates Construction Permits 4100 and 4127, the March 2018 hydrogeological monitoring plan and later leachate, engineering, gas-monitoring and surface-emission plans.
Attachment A is the 2024 aerial-topography site map showing property and permitted-waste boundaries, active and closed areas and future cells.
evidentiaryBoundary: This record establishes the landfill's 2024-2029 operating authorization and incorporated operating plans. It does not provide per-load leachate deliveries to Cadillac, Cadillac receiving or billing records, PFAS analytical results, an exact final-delivery date or a demonstrated PFAS migration pathway to Plett Road.

queueResolution.reason: The renamed copy adds no new evidentiary content beyond the exact operating-license record already indexed; none of the remaining transaction-level, synchronized-sampling or hydrogeologic requests is closed.
